_source: Lincoln Learning's guides give no per-week granularity of their own - assessments are listed per Learning Period only, with no week attached (confirmed against the 38 district LL pacing guides and against Appendix A's own LL cells, both lesson/checkpoint lists with no week ranges). Loren confirmed 8/30/26: students do one LL lesson per subject per school day, so week-level pacing is derived from the district's 2026-27 school calendar (26/27 Visions School Year Calendar) rather than transcribed from a guide. Lesson totals per Learning Period come from the fixed table already established for the Semester Plan Generator tool (semester-plan-generator_ll_lesson_ranges.json, '_fixed_ranges': same 180-lesson table at every grade and subject: LP1 1-15, LP2 16-40, LP3 41-63, LP4 64-78, LP5 79-95, LP6 96-113, LP7 114-133, LP8 134-148, LP9 149-169, LP10 170-180). Each LP's lesson count is divided across that LP's weeks (per the shared WEEK_WINDOWS), weighted toward weeks with more instructional days per the calendar; ties and remainders go to the higher-day-count week first. The calendar's actual instructional days total 175 for the year, five fewer than the fixed table's 180 - this file follows the fixed table (Loren's explicit instruction 8/30/26), so the day-count weighting is a proportion guide only, not a literal one-lesson-per-instructional-day count.
_added: 8/30/26. This single map is universal - the fixed lesson-range table is identical at every grade and subject, and this file uses only that table plus the calendar, nothing grade- or subject-specific. Applies to every LL course: Math (K-8, IM1), ELA (TK, K-8), Science (K-8), HSS (K-8). No checkpoints, module-mastery names, or assessment text included, per Loren's direction - lesson numbers only.
